text:
rafael: Pushed a new variant of the roles grid + invite flow to Figma: https://figma.com/file/XYZ789

rafael: Two variants: "contextual" (roles inline with short permission chips) and "dense" (compact table). Need feedback on discoverability + keyboard nav.

june: Contextual feels friendlier. But the permission chips are vague. Can we show verb-based summaries on hover like 'manage billing', 'deploy models'? That helps non-technical PMs.

priya: Agree with hover summaries. Also saw an a11y issue: the SSO toggle uses color-only state (green/gray). Add an explicit label and aria-pressed state. Maybe change label to "Require SSO for org sign-in" (more descriptive).

ben: Small copy tweak for invite modal: current CTA "Send" is too generic. Options: "Invite users" or dynamic "Invite 3 users and assign roles". Dynamic is extra work but clearer.

rafael: Good call. I'm leaning dynamic. Also note the invite drawer loses scroll position when you open a second drawer (role details)  could be jarring on mobile.

maya: On keyboard nav: tab order in contextual variant goes: role checkbox -> role name -> permission chips -> save. If we make permission chips interactive, ensure they don't break linear tab flow. Consider a single "preview permissions" button per row instead of many tabbable chips.

priya: For screen reader users we should announce effective permissions summary when focus lands on the role row: "Role: Billing Manager. Effective permissions: view invoices, issue refunds." Use aria-live polite.

ben: Audit log nav: we should persist the time range + actor filter when switching between settings pages. Right now it resets to last 7 days. QA found this caused missed events during incident replay.

qa-bot: QA note: reproducible on Chrome/Win and Safari/Mac. Steps: open org settings > audit log > apply filter > click Roles > back to Audit log > filters cleared. File: QA-7331.

june: For dense table: can we add a compact affordance (three-dot menu) to reveal role actions (edit, clone, delete) so rows stay clean? Extra click but cleaner scan.

rafael: Thinking: combine both patterns  dense table by default, contextual overlay on hover for power users (preview + actions). Need to ensure hover alternatives for keyboard and touch.

priya: Accessibility checklist: color contrast for chips, focus ring visible at 1.5x default, aria-labels for icons, no reliance on hover for essential info. I'll write a one-pager.

ben: One more microcopy nudge: when removing admin privileges in role edit modal, add an inline warning: "Removing admin will revoke access to org billing and Dedicated clusters." Clear effect helps reduce mistakes.

rafael: Action items:
- implement permission hover preview (or keyboard accessible preview) for role rows (rafael + design)
- change SSO toggle copy to "Require SSO for org sign-in" and add aria-describedby explaining session impact (priya)
- dynamic invite CTA copy (ben)
- persist audit log filters across nav (eng ticket, file QA-7331)
- dense table + hover overlay design exploration (june)
- accessibility one-pager with checklist (priya)

design-bot: Created ticket PROD-4981: "Roles grid: permission preview + a11y checklist" assigned to design.

qa-bot: Logged QA-7331 for filter persistence and linked to PROD-4981.

maya: Thanks all. Can design upload the keyboard-flow prototype (tab/shift-tab) by EOD so eng can estimate the work? Also ping infra about audit state persistence complexity.

rafael: Will do. Uploading a clickable prototype in 2 hours.

june: I'll sketch the dense+overlay variant and add notes about touch fallback.

priya: I'll draft the a11y one-pager and include sample aria attributes.

ben: I'll prototype dynamic CTA copy in the component lib and share code snippet.

rafael: Great sync. Closing thread for now, follow-ups in the tickets. :v:
